description: Use this when the user asks about the history of a place or a building, what stood there before, how it changed over the centuries, or wants an audio guide for a walk. Lists the Builtalist stories of places through time (the Acropolis, the Alhambra, the Prado…) and its audio guides, with a short summary and a link to each.

texto.description: A place, a building or a city: "Alhambra", "Madrid". Without it, all of them.

name: buscar_historias
title: Buscar historias y guías
